pairs: Verbum quod factum est ad Jeremiam, de omni populo Juda, in anno quarto Joakim filii Josiæ regis Juda (ipse est annus primus Nabuchodonosor regis Babylonis),
The word that came to Jeremiah about all the people of Judah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim, the son of Josiah, the king of Judah. The same is the first year of Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon.
quod locutus est Jeremias propheta ad omnem populum Juda,
And the prophet Jeremiah spoke to all the people of Judah,
and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem,
A tertiodecimo anno Josiæ filii Amon regis Juda,
“From the thirteenth year of Josiah, the son of Amon, the king of Judah,
factum est verbum Domini ad me,
the word of the Lord has been given to me,
and I have spoken to you,
rising while it was still night, and speaking,
and yet you have not listened.
Et misit Dominus ad vos omnes servos suos prophetas,
And the Lord has sent to you all his servants, the prophets,
and yet you have not listened,
neque inclinastis aures vestras ut audiretis,
and you have not inclined your ears, so that you would hear,
Revertimini unusquisque a via sua mala,
each one from his evil way,
et habitabitis in terra quam dedit Dominus vobis
And you shall dwell in the land,
which the Lord has given to you and to your fathers,
from ancient times and even forever.
et nolite ire post deos alienos,
And do not choose to go after strange gods,
so that you would serve them
neque me ad iracundiam provocetis in operibus manuum vestrarum,
And do not provoke me to wrath by the works of your hands.
And then I will not afflict you.
And yet you have not listened to me,
ut me ad iracundiam provocaretis in operibus manuum vestrarum,
and so you have provoked me to anger with the works of your hands,
Because of this, thus says the Lord of hosts:
Pro eo quod non audistis verba mea,
“Since you have not listened to my words,
ecce ego mittam et assumam universas cognationes aquilonis,
behold, I will send for and take all the associates of the north,
et Nabuchodonosor regem Babylonis servum meum,
and Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon, my servant,
et adducam eos super terram istam,
and I will lead them over this land,
et super omnes nationes quæ in circuitu illius sunt:
and over all the nations that are around it.
et ponam eos in stuporem et in sibilum, et in solitudines sempiternas.
and I will set them in the midst of stupor and hissing, and continual desolations.
Perdamque ex eis vocem gaudii et vocem lætitiæ,
And I will perish from them the voice of gladness and the voice of rejoicing,
the voice of the groom and the voice of the bride,
the sound of the millstone and the light of the lamp.
Et erit universa terra hæc in solitudinem,
And this entire land will be in desolation and in stupor.
And all these nations will serve the king of Babylon,
et servient omnes gentes istæ regi Babylonis septuaginta annis.
And when the seventy years have been completed,
visitabo super regem Babylonis et super gentem illam,
I will visit their iniquity upon the king of Babylon,
and upon the land of the Chaldeans,
et ponam illam in solitudines sempiternas.
And I will set it in continual desolations.
Et adducam super terram illam omnia verba mea,
And I will lead over that land all my words,
which I have spoken against it,
omne quod scriptum est in libro isto,
all that has been written in this book,
quæcumque prophetavit Jeremias adversum omnes gentes:
everything whatsoever that Jeremiah has prophesied against all the nations.
et reddam eis secundum opera eorum,
And I will repay them according to their works
and according to the deeds of their hands.”
For thus says the Lord of hosts,
Sume calicem vini furoris hujus de manu mea,
“Take the chalice of the wine of this fury from my hand.
et propinabis de illo cunctis gentibus ad quas ego mittam te.
And you shall cause all the nations, to which I will send you, to drink from it.
et turbabuntur et insanient a facie gladii quem ego mittam inter eos.
and be stirred up, and become maddened, before the face of the sword that I will send among them.”
Et accepi calicem de manu Domini,
And I received the chalice from the hand of the Lord,
et propinavi cunctis gentibus ad quas misit me Dominus,
and I caused all the nations, to which the Lord has sent me, to drink from it:
so that I gave them over to desolation,
just as it is this day.
and his servants, and his leaders,
and the entire populace in general:
all the kings of the land of the south,
and all the kings of the land of the Philistines,
and all the kings of Tyre,
and all the kings of Sidon,
et regibus terræ insularum qui sunt trans mare:
and the kings of the land of the islands that are across the sea,
et universis qui attonsi sunt in comam:
and all those who have shaved off their hair,
and all the kings of Arabia,
and all the kings of the west,
and all the kings of Zimri,
and all the kings of Elam,
and all the kings of Media,
all the kings of the north from near to far,
and all the kingdoms upon the face of the earth,
et omnibus regnis terræ quæ super faciem ejus sunt:
et rex Sesach bibet post eos.
all these shall drink after them.
And you shall say to them:
Thus says the Lord of hosts,
neque surgatis a facie gladii quem ego mittam inter vos.
And you shall not rise up before the face of the sword that I will send among you.
Cumque noluerint accipere calicem de manu tua ut bibant,
And if they refuse to receive the cup from your hand and to drink,
dices ad eos: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum:
you shall say to them: Thus says the Lord of hosts:
quia ecce in civitate in qua invocatum est nomen meum ego incipiam affligere,
I am beginning to afflict the city in which my name has been invoked,
and will you be innocent and immune?
gladium enim ego voco super omnes habitatores terræ,
For I will call the sword over all the inhabitants of the earth,
Et tu prophetabis ad eos omnia verba hæc,
And you shall prophesy to them all these words,
and you shall say to them:
The Lord will roar from on high,
et de habitaculo sancto suo dabit vocem suam:
and he will utter his voice from his holy habitation. When roaring,
he will roar over the place of his beauty. He will call out,
celeuma quasi calcantium concinetur adversus omnes habitatores terræ.
like those who chant in rhythm as they trample the grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.
Pervenit sonitus usque ad extrema terræ,
The sound of it will penetrate even to the ends of the earth.
For the Lord is entering into judgment with the nations.
He himself is entering into judgment with all flesh.
I have delivered the impious to the sword,
Thus says the Lord of hosts: “Behold,
Ecce afflictio egredietur de gente in gentem,
an affliction will go forth from nation to nation,
et turbo magnus egredietur a summitatibus terræ.
and a great whirlwind will go forth from the ends of the earth.
Et erunt interfecti Domini in die illa,
And the slain of the Lord will be, on that day,
a summo terræ usque ad summum ejus:
from one end of the earth, even to the other end.
and they will not be gathered,
and they will not be buried.
in sterquilinium super faciem terræ jacebunt.
They will lie upon the face of the earth like dung.
quia completi sunt dies vestri ut interficiamini,
For the days have been completed that lead to your slaughter
And you will fall like precious vessels.
And escape will flee from the shepherds,
and safety will flee from the nobility of the flock.”
There is a voice of outcry from the shepherds,
and a wailing among the nobles among the flock!
For the Lord has laid waste to their pastures.
et conticuerunt arva pacis a facie iræ furoris Domini.
And the fields of peace have been silenced before the face of the fury of the Lord.
He has abandoned those he sheltered like a lion.
quia facta est terra eorum in desolationem a facie iræ columbæ,
For the earth has become a desolation before the face of the anger of the dove,
et a facie iræ furoris Domini.
and before the face of the fury of the Lord.
